contract: GET /api/custom-metadata-providers is admin-only: 401 without a token, 403 for a normal user. The admin receives {providers: [...]} with one serialised model row per stored provider (id, name, mediaType, url, authHeaderValue, extraData, createdAt, updatedAt; no slug) and an empty array on the fixture state. The web settings page reads providers and the table shows name, url and authHeaderValue.
exceptions: Unexecuted here: no route in v2.37.2 creates an update or reorder of providers, so the admin list is observed with zero and three stored rows.

invariants.contract: GET /api/custom-metadata-providers answers 401 without a token and 403 for both non-admin fixture users. As the admin it answers 200 with {providers: []} on the fixture state, and after three creates it returns three rows keyed by their created ids, each with the created name, mediaType, url, authHeaderValue, parseable createdAt/updatedAt and no slug.
